hints.content: In order to find $F'(3)$, we should first find an expression for $F'(x)$ (for any input $x$) in terms of $f$, $g$, and their derivatives.

So $F'(x)=f'\Bigl(g(x)\Bigr)\cdot g'(x)$.

We can now plug $x=3$ into this expression and evaluate. Here is the table of values again, for your convenience:

$x$ | $f(x)$ | $g(x)$ | $f'(x)$ | $g'(x)$
:-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$0$ | $0$ | $-3$ | $2$ | $1$
$3$ | $-3$ | $0$ | $-4$ | $1$

Let's plug in those values!

$\begin{align}
F'(3)&=f'\Bigl(g(3)\Bigr)\cdot g'(3)
\\\\
&=f'(0)\cdot 1&&\gray{g(3)=0\text{ , }g'(3)=1}
\\\\
&=2\cdot 1&&\gray{f'(0)=2}
\\\\
&=2
\end{align}$
